task: Welcome to another exciting game of TextWorld! Here is how to play! First of all, you could, like, open the chest drawer in the bedroom. And then, retrieve the old key from the chest drawer within the bedroom. After that, make sure that the wooden door is unlocked. And then, make it so that the wooden door is wide open. Then, move east. Following that, doublecheck that the screen door in the kitchen is ajar. After opening the screen door, make an effort to go east. Next, head south. Then, lift the half of a bag of chips from the floor of the garden. Then, head north. Then, go to the west. After that, rest the half of a bag of chips on the stove within the kitchen. And once you've done that, you win!
